name: Explain what was built: phase-grounded, suggested shape, glossary, formulas
objective: Explain documents come from what was built: the explain writes only from the code and the phases' records (no research of its own, codebase-only, a research phase offered first when no phase covers the subject), suggests the reader and the shape at its one confirmation, reads easily with visuals first, and carries a glossary (term links shown as a definition window on hover or tap, plus a glossary section) and typeset formulas with a plain-words legend, kept across translation and print. The glossary and formula surfaces are designed on a signed canvas first (build-after), then built in the server, reader, plugin and the workspace's explain route.
